data.action: 抱着包裹全力奔跑，衣摆飞扬
data.description: 【能天使 · 极速派送】繁华拥挤的龙门老街上，能天使双手紧紧抱着盖着绝密火漆印章的急件包裹，在摩肩接踵的人流与巷道障碍物之间以令人咋舌的高速全速穿梭奔跑，红色的防风外套在身后猎猎飞扬——「借过借过！企鹅物流极速特派！迟到一秒可是要扣老板奖金的！」
data.promptProse: A sealed express parcel is held firmly in both of Exusiai's arms as she races through Lungmen's crowded old street. Her red delivery windbreaker streams behind her cargo pants and sneakers. From a dynamic low angle, nearby obstacles pass across the foreground while shopfronts narrow down the lane. Bright daylight illuminates her face and parcel top, with short shadows anchoring her running feet.
data.title: 能天使 · 极速派送
